# v0.1.1 release staging

`RetroArch-GBA-LCD-v0.1.1-KPA-arm64.apk` is the persistent-release-key build
for KONKR Pocket ADVANCE. `GBA-Native-LCD-Shader-v0.1.1.zip` is the standalone
six-pass GLSL shader bundle for manual installation.

The binaries are intentionally ignored by Git and are uploaded as GitHub
Release assets. Verify both files against `SHA256SUMS` before installation.
